### Marriage and family

Aaron and Bandy are the fathers of **Penelope, Penny, and Rosalie**. Their family life is in Los Angeles, with Taiwan and Taipei regarded as home. The [Aaron and Bandy relationship history](https://chatgpt.com/space/page_f9fcdcae3bfc8191a1c0b621e239d6e4) follows their private marriage becoming more visible at work, their parenting disagreements and their family plans. Gingerbread Cheesecake recalls seven years of marriage, and their comms call it a California marriage; an exact wedding date or year is not inferred. The Ginger Bible’s old age 35 and COO metadata remain historical beside the current PI’s 37 and Director role. ([Ginger Bible](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1vcmNjbjWgZcUSayzi2NFAT5hA3n_XHb9/edit?usp=drivesdk&ouid=112521746920599110219&rtpof=true&sd=true), FACT-0001–0012.)

Aaron considers the partners equal and describes coming home to Bandy as his only true peace. He thinks about him during work and believes Bandy alone sees the softness he hides behind his controlled professional presentation. Their marriage explicitly rejects secrets. He enjoys affection, handholding and kisses, uses petnames including baby, darling and angel, and remains excited to see his husband after years together. Private intimacy and couple-time plans are preserved non-graphically in their history. (FACT-0016–0020, 0027–0029, 0032–0046; [Gingerbread House](https://bluehour.jcink.net/index.php?showtopic=75279).)

He supports a large, comfortable home, separate bedrooms for the girls and a mortgage, while recognising that safety and togetherness matter more than further grandeur. He drinks coffee at work and tea in quiet home evenings, dislikes being awakened, exercises and uses almond milk in protein shakes. Bandy coordinates late-meeting dinners and his pressed suits; Aaron has taken business calls from the gym to save time. He feels guilty about missed family life and wants to be present rather than treating Bandy’s househusband role as permission to remain absent. (FACT-0054–0061, 0101–0108; [Gingerbread House](https://bluehour.jcink.net/index.php?showtopic=75279).)

A strict upbringing and no current contact with his parents shape his comparatively permissive parenting. When Penny accidentally breaks a vase passed down by Bandy’s mother, Aaron wants reassurance and a proportionate response. The fathers negotiate safe play areas and accountability; he expressly trusts Bandy’s parenting. He worries about sleepovers elsewhere, promises to clear work for a Friday 2 p.m. school nativity, and wants the girls’ childhood to stay simple. Both fathers favour university education, but he resists their idol ambitions while Bandy defends genuine interests. **They have not agreed how to support the girls’ performing interests while addressing Aaron’s concerns**, confirmed by Lex on 5 November 2026 (UQ38). Nativity attendance, children’s exact ages and their origins are not established here. (FACT-0062–0084; [Gingerbread House, offsets 50–90](https://bluehour.jcink.net/index.php?showtopic=75279&st=50).)

The Jacaranda launch is his first project led from inception, with Taein and Seojun involved; he is nervous about the speech and public response, and Bandy accompanies him. Following the shooting, fear of losing Bandy prompts family time and a question about a third child, whose answer is not shown. A month in Taiwan later occurs; a second marriage ceremony there remains proposed. He wants the daughters to learn Cantonese and supports extra Hokkien classes, including for possible future study or work in Taiwan without language disadvantage. (FACT-0037–0038, 0086–0094, 0109–0119, 0151; [Moon Cake](https://bluehour.jcink.net/index.php?showtopic=79345); [Gingerbread House, offset 250](https://bluehour.jcink.net/index.php?showtopic=75279&st=250).)

His working relationship with Taein combines mentorship and promotion advocacy with an expectation of transparency, costed plans and inclusion in high-level decisions. He personally helps Hyemi with temporary accommodation after learning about the concealed dormitory move, then seeks a controlled catch-up with Taein. He values Mew’s bold management ideas, supports artist security and equal treatment of Hyunwoo, and considers Jinseok’s coming-out strategy through caution, controlled approval and a later suggested delay until after Cakey Wakey. These source proposals do not establish that every budget, share grant or announcement was implemented. (FACT-0124–0141; [management comms](https://bluehour.jcink.net/index.php?showtopic=53323); Cakey Wakey canon year remains 2025.)

In the [management messages and support reference](https://chatgpt.com/space/page_286f02203ec88191b9830c37c016d854), Aaron asks for the proposed statement’s substance before agreeing to front it. He welcomes the reported plans for stronger security and support for consensual idol relationships, while telling Byungjoon that he wants involvement in the high-level conversations. Byungjoon’s encouragement coexists with his messenger-only role; the reviewed exchange does not establish an implemented budget increase, published statement or Aaron’s acquisition of shares. Ginger SRC-0001–0015; [Victoria Sponge](https://bluehour.jcink.net/index.php?showtopic=56218).

His mentorship of Taein includes explicit praise and a wish not to lose him at Leaf,with room to lead a show’s name and concept. He asks for costs,timelines and board-ready figures alongside this confidence. In Jinseok’s disclosure discussion,Aaron promises privacy,initially argues for private dating,then supports an interview plan before later proposing a delay; his competing commercial caution is retained. Later messages make his friendship explicit: he calls himself Taein’s friend and manager,and says he wants him happy with a long career alongside him despite not understanding the reported CREEM CHEESE choice. He apologises after the locked-dorm dispute and asks for continued updates. Announced promotion terms,an official letter and an inspection are not shown completed in this range. Ginger CLM-0017–0021,0027–0038,0051–0066,0078–0083,0092–0104,0113–0119; [Walnut Squares](https://bluehour.jcink.net/index.php?showtopic=53323); [complete management reference](https://chatgpt.com/space/page_286f02203ec88191b9830c37c016d854).

When missing-idol news makes returning to Leaf emotionally difficult, Bandy encourages him to lead and contact his protégé. Aaron says he can strategise even while feeling out of his depth. Possible days away and video calls with the girls are an agreed expectation rather than a solved crisis. The source’s isolated “boyfriend” phrase and more-than-ten-year headquarters tenure remain qualified comparisons in [the full references](https://chatgpt.com/space/page_f9fcdcae3bfc8191a1c0b621e239d6e4); message posting dates do not automatically date the action. (FACT-0120–0123; REL-078; [Gingerbread House, offsets 250–260](https://bluehour.jcink.net/index.php?showtopic=75279&st=250).)

Aaron leaves breakfast in the kitchen for Bandy and the girls on his first workday after their month away. He offers a large bouquet of roses, while the daughters’ birthday-purse request prompts his wish for simple childhoods and ordinary school backpacks. A separate errands exchange includes bread for the girls’ next lunch and almond milk for his protein shakes; purchases and the offered bouquet are not shown. His isolated “toddlers” description remains source wording without assigning the girls exact ages. ([Family messages](https://chatgpt.com/space/page_6db94fb09f448191b155a340ae7e10a4), CLM-0540–0553, 0595–0608.)

He sometimes tells colleagues stories about his marriage and checks with Bandy that this is welcome; Bandy explicitly agrees. During the missing-idol crisis he prefers Bandy to remain outside the operational response, with Bandy caring for the family instead. He promises a meal with the girls afterwards, and another text when he has a chance. That meal, completed calls and the crisis outcome remain unshown in this ledger range. ([Gingerbread House, offsets 200 and 270](https://bluehour.jcink.net/index.php?showtopic=75279&st=200); CLM-0560–0566, 0629–0635.)

### Lemon relationship and everyday context

[Adrian and Shane relationship history](https://chatgpt.com/space/page_cf32cbf9cc48819195982b4e9e3019f9) brings together the approved Lemon Bible’s complete 234-row curated layer, reviewed 5 October 2026. The [facts and two profiles](https://chatgpt.com/space/page_5f3303e884f8819192432b6adf786232) and [chronology/continuity reference](https://chatgpt.com/space/page_395107c430fc819194378305f1322d03) retain its exact claims, source locators and limits. His current PI partnership, age 26 and 11 April birthday remain the current reference. On 24 October, 50 further complete retained Cleaned Posts records were reviewed, bringing that separate evidence layer to 59 of 1,182. The exact new IDs, metadata and retained text are saved in the continuity reference; no full original forum reading is claimed.

**Work and public/private temperament:** The curated sources describe newsreading plus weather/headline duties, varied early and late broadcasts, courtesy and concern for his professional image. He can address a nation and command a room while still preferring a quiet, well-lit bar and feeling nervous at unfamiliar industry parties. These are setting-specific descriptions, not a diagnosis. His employer and exact formal role remain unestablished. LEM-F0963, F0995–F0996, F1016; [lemon dream bars](https://bluehour.jcink.net/index.php?showtopic=71430).

**Guarded courtship:** Adrian initially reserves “Ade” for friends and excludes Shane, continuing to engage despite resistant banter. During the private apartment visit he hesitates, smokes one cigarette to settle his nerves and admits Shane’s persistence has become endearing. He secretly watches Shane’s television content when unable to sleep and deliberately keeps a cold facade. The source says months of messages where a curated claim says weeks; neither duration is selected. Smoking frequency and explicit later nickname permission remain unknown. LEM-F0964–F0969, F0979–F0982; [lemon elderflower bake](https://bluehour.jcink.net/index.php?showtopic=54250). The early retained messages give his own distinction: stoic and no-nonsense is who he is, rather than an image he maintains. After agreeing to give Shane some time, he frames it as a way to be left alone; Shane openly says attention makes him want more. Their payment, escort and kidney remarks are exaggerated banter, without establishing a transaction, occupation or medical act. [LEM-S01-P0025–P0055](https://bluehour.jcink.net/index.php?showtopic=53560&st=20); retained source review 24 October 2026.

**Commitment and care:** His earlier refusal of a serious relationship and fear of being a poor or unromantic boyfriend are historical self-assessments. Later he agrees to try a solid bond, invites Shane to move permanently into his apartment, leaves food and snacks before work and asks him to rest. Cohabitation is explicitly described after Shane’s home crisis accelerates the move; the exact address, action date and possessions remain unset. The Bible’s stored dates do not automatically date these actions. LEM-F0998–F1002, F1006–F1012; [lemon meringue pie](https://bluehour.jcink.net/index.php?showtopic=53560).

**Privacy and space:** Adrian describes Shane as his partner and part of his life, rather than a trophy. They prefer privacy without denial. After a reported press leak, Adrian proposes a confirmation with a privacy request; publication and reception are not demonstrated in the reviewed excerpts. **Lex has no further answer about the leaker or whether the proposed confirmation happened** (5 November 2026, UQ26), so those details remain unknown. When discussing possible shared work, he proposes separate rooms and friend time rather than Shane feeling sent to a hotel. These are intentions and conversations, not imposed rules or a completed press event. LEM-F1018–F1025; [lemon meringue pie](https://bluehour.jcink.net/index.php?showtopic=53560).

Their later “next steps” remain undefined, with no engagement, marriage or official anniversary inferred. He describes himself as socially awkward rather than afraid. He eats oatmeal with raisins and sultanas, enjoys quiet meals, baths, cuddling and slow mornings with Jaehyun, and cannot play an instrument. Yuseop’s relationship with Siwoo begins in sustained attention: Siwoo was one of the few trainees who bothered to talk to him beyond a brief greeting. The comms show them living together, becoming friends and partners in crime, and developing mutual attraction. He asks direct questions about expectations and agrees with Siwoo that private matters must not damage their working relationship. Later material confirms consensual intimacy, while intercourse discussed earlier remains unconfirmed. Clementine Juice CLE-F0049–0072; Clementine Posset CHROW-017–018.

His confidence is accompanied by fear of letting people down. He trains hard, wants to be ready and worries about being the weakest member. Siwoo’s praise and promise to look out for him help him feel supported. At CRAZHES’ Jacaranda debut on Lex’s confirmed 14 February 2025 action date, Yuseop feels proud and ready, offers a hand discreetly between the makeup chairs and shares Siwoo’s excitement. Later they keep a routine of early calls and check-ins, and Yuseop worries about Kia being separated from Jaehyun during lockdown. He wants to arrive early and scout the space, then becomes anxious about looking out of place when the other groupmates are not there. Siwoo asks what he needs and follows his wishes; Yuseop warms Siwoo’s arms in the taxi, adjusts his fringe backstage and instinctively checks his steadiness during choreography. **Wiki biography and small details**, reviewed 30 September 2026. [Source: Choi Taeyang](https://leafentertainment.fandom.com/wiki/Choi_Taeyang).

**Identity and background:** Choi Taeyang (최태양), preferred **Tae**, Usani fashion designer, entrepreneur, **Verve founder / CEO / principal creative director**. Ethnically Korean; born **2 August 1999**, **Mabda Island, Usan**, to **Choi Minho and Han Jisoo**. Hometown field **Los Angeles**; active **2018–present**. Infobox **ISFP**, personality/trivia **ISFP-T**, **chaotic neutral**, social category **Creative**. Face claim **Yang Jeongin**. **Leo**, **Rabbit**. Speaks **Korean, English and Japanese**. **Lactose intolerant**, with **migraines, insomnia and dyslexia**. No height or blood type is supplied.

**Childhood and first designs:** Wealthy Choi family with private education and high expectations about work, presentation and discipline. As a child he dismantled objects to learn construction, noticing texture, packaging, light, silhouettes and visual imbalance. Quiet until irritated and observant in formal rooms. Private tutoring, elite schooling and artistic instruction covered languages, music, design, business etiquette and classical art. His adolescent room became a design space with fabric samples, magazine cuttings, sketches, watch catalogues, leather scraps and mood boards.

School-break internships in the Choi business network became informal design research: sketches during meetings and attention to status conveyed by watch straps, linings, cuffs, shoes, fragrance and unguarded wealthy people's clothing. His early online capsule preceded Verve, was experimental and influenced by Capitolium youth culture, proving demand outside his family network.

**Verve timeline:** Founded in **Capitolium in 2018** using a **US$1,000 loan from a grandparent**. The small loan encouraged resourceful, digital, direct-to-consumer beginnings despite family wealth. First products: reconstructed jackets, narrow trousers, handmade chokers, metallic accessories, altered shirts, stagewear basics and small leather-goods runs. Customers included creatives, styling assistants, underground performers, art students, models and young socialites.

**Pulse Zero**, the first widely circulated capsule, established black/silver/pale tones, red campaign details and close flash photography. Rapid growth **2019–2022**; **Capitolium showroom opened 2019**, then distinct design, sampling, celebrity-fitting, campaign-styling and private-client studios. **Capitolium Heat (2020)** mixed humid city dressing, sharp unisex tailoring, open collars, metal and red lighting. **Afterimage (2021)** used smoked colours, colder polish, flash and paparazzi-style imagery. **Verve Atelier formalised in 2022** for made-to-measure/high fashion, red carpets, runway and private entertainment fittings.

Los Angeles expansion placed him near entertainment companies, magazine production, photographers, stylists, models and expatriate wealth. No exact relocation year is given. He values its access to performers, music-video sets, cameras and clients. Still attends **Usan Fashion Week** and maintains his Mabda residence, while international expansion creates tension with his Usani identity.

**Leadership and design:** Controlled, demanding and attentive to fabric, campaign framing, casting, store interiors, fragrance bottles, logos, jewellery sizing, runway light and final styling. Rejects cheap stitches, awkward movement under flash, weak shoulders, mismatched metals, over-sweet fragrance and garments that only work standing still or from one angle. Severe but precise mentor who explains failures; his criticism is usually quiet, brief and technically specific. Staff admire his eye while stories of temper, sharp silence and seemingly impossible standards intimidate interns and assistants.

Visual codes: narrow elongated silhouettes; **black, silver, ivory, smoke grey and Verve red**; sharp collars and open necklines; **leather, silk, structured cotton, mesh, wool and satin**; silver hardware and watch details; flash-friendly clothes working across runway, street, videos and private events. Understated branding, masculine tailoring with softer sensuality, youth culture with old-money finishing, control and visual tension. Dislikes **fast fashion, plagiarism, poor workmanship, clutter, trend-chasing and logo-only luxury**. Removes logos when the cut can stand alone.

Verve's logo is a narrow, widely spaced uppercase wordmark with a sharp central R. Luxury materials favour black/white/silver/smoke; entertainment campaigns add red. Playful mass-market branding is reserved for deliberately limited or ironic products. Mabda collections draw on sea air, pale stone, villas, night driving, resort darkness and island privilege.

**Leaf and business connections:** Verve supplies idol styling, editorials, red carpets, comeback campaigns and video wardrobes, especially sharper/mature/darker/high-fashion concepts requiring movement. Named Leaf associations include **TO@ME, Sunday's, Hunter and Hyunwoo**, plus **BEDROCK** collaborations. A caption shows **Hunter and Liang** in a Verve editorial fitting. Verve aligned with **Edison Lee's Consortium**, connecting Leaf, **Woopill** and BEDROCK and amplifying idol, magazine, endorsement and fan-fashion demand. No exact joining date is given.

**Personality and public image:** Confident self-perception; relatives see **proud**, friends **admiring**, colleagues **respectful**, lovers **enamoured**, media **intrigued**. Listed traits: **ambitious, meticulous, visionary, innovative, independent, disciplined, passionate, charismatic, introspective, resilient, sophisticated, pragmatic, assertive, enigmatic, tenacious, intuitive and fashionable**. Irritated by lateness, clutter, poor workmanship, plagiarism, passive-aggression and responsibility-avoiding small talk. Emotion often becomes readable through sharper silence. Dry, direct humour about badly behaving garments.

Enjoys **luxury cars, vintage watches, espresso, haute couture, rooftop parties, minimalist architecture and avant-garde art**. Can charm a room while being impatient with shallow questions, inefficiency, insincerity and poor dress. Controlled interviews, guarded privacy and severe style coexist with a domestic cat-loving image.

**Relationships and residence:** **Homoromantic, homosexual and polyamorous**. Boyfriends **Baek Yujun**, Verve fashion assistant, and **Elias Lim**, delivery driver. Yujun's professional oversight/reporting is kept separate from Taeyang's direct authority. Fans frame their relationship through shared fashion-house pressures; Elias is seen as grounding and outside that hierarchy. Taeyang discusses polyamory matter-of-factly while keeping its private mechanics private. **Elias first developed a relationship with Taeyang through his regular deliveries to the Verve office**, which drew Taeyang’s interest and led to their intertwined relationship. Lex supplies that formation context without specifying additional private agreements (5 November 2026, UQ10).

Lives with his boyfriends in **Redondo Beach, Los Angeles**; also maintains a **Mabda Island villa**, his declared home. The villa is minimal, expensive and cat-centred: large windows, controlled scent, polished stone, neutral interiors, carefully stored garments and cat spaces. Mabda represents background, privilege, isolation and visual discipline; a source of taste rather than uncomplicated comfort.

**Cats and care:** Seven cats: **Majesty, Saffron, Duchess, Mochi, Gatsby, Hazel and Pablo**. Serious about their welfare; dislikes long travel without at least some nearby. Cats feature in his public domestic image; staff joke about their studio approval. His cat-versus-polyester joke places the cat first.

**Philanthropy:** Supports arts education, young-designer funding, sustainability and quiet **cat rescue work**. Verve's **First Cut** offers selected young designers studio access, mentorship, materials and campaign opportunities. Particularly backs emerging Usani designers in tailoring, fabrics, stagewear and luxury construction; personally reviews portfolios and gives blunt technical feedback.

**Reception and criticism:** Praised as a defining young Usani designer and for connecting fashion with entertainment imagery and global expansion. Criticism centres on severity, privilege, elitism, inaccessible high prices, scarcity, idol exposure, intense work culture and a perceived departure from Usani roots through Los Angeles. Supporters treat exclusivity as discipline; critics question a culture mixing fear and perfection. The Yujun workplace relationship remains discussed despite separate reporting. Replies to criticism are rare, short and controlled.

The Consortium passage displays **Verve** but links to **Taehwan**; that erroneous target does not make Taehwan the fashion house. The complete [Verve brand article, saved revision 4461](https://leafentertainment.fandom.com/wiki/Verve?oldid=4461), adds the purchases behind Taeyang’s US$1,000 grandparent loan: a second-hand industrial sewing machine, deadstock fabric, a garment rail and packaging for fifty orders. Freddie provides grounding at overwhelming industry events and wants to offer immediate care when Ollie is hospitalised. They explicitly agree that care must be reciprocal. Freddie enjoys focusing on him when he is unwell and prioritises recovery over immediate intimacy. He apologises after his schedule frustration overlooks Ollie’s restricted travel freedom, and later reassures him that learning more about idol life does not make him want to leave.

He explicitly says he is not seeing or sleeping with anyone else. At the Halloween party he wears a genie costume and is initially denied entry, leaving him embarrassed and overwhelmed. **Wiki biography and small details**, reviewed 30 September 2026. [Source: Happy](https://leafentertainment.fandom.com/wiki/Happy).

**Identity and background:** Geum Jung (**금정** in infobox, **금 정** in prose), **Happy (해피 / 𝐇𝐀𝐏𝐏𝐘)**. South Korean singer, songwriter and performer; **PUMPKING oldest member / lead vocalist**. **Canonical birthday: 24 October 1998**, selected from the existing candidates under Lex’s confirmed oldest-member rule on 30 September 2026, matching the calendar and PI age 27. The wiki’s 1999 prose is a superseded source version. Both give **Daegu**; wiki hometown **Seoul**. **ISFJ**, face claim **Lim Jimin**. Group debut **1 October 2023**, active **2023–present**. No height/blood type supplied.

**Early life and training:** Musical family; church choirs and youth theatre, early baritone encouraged classical study. **Daegu School of Performing Arts**, vocal-performance major, contemporary and operatic techniques; briefly in a high-school **rock ensemble**. Auditioned for **SK Entertainment in 2016** with a cappella **Zombie by The Cranberries**. Source says **six years training**, while heading says **2016–2018**. One of the first vocal trainees; **Shadowline** theatrical/high-concept programme was axed after Leaf absorption. Chosen as PUMPKING founder **early 2023**. Guide vocals and uncredited harmony coaching for pre-debut artists established **Coach Happy**.

**Group and solo career:** Debut single **Halloween Night**, 1 October 2023. Deep resonant tone and cinematic vibrato; sustained final note **Phantom Waltz (2023)**, whispered bridge **Spooky Serenade (2024)**. Sometimes acts as **studio vocal director**, shaping harmonies and arrangements.

**Night Parade (2021)**, first solo track / **Shadow Bride OST**; **Whisper in the Fog (2022)** with **Arianna Reyes**, gothic ballad/neo-soul; **Grave Sonata (2023)** with **Leaf Philharmonic Ensemble**, called **VerdantFest 2023: Theatrical Edition** in narrative and **VerdantFest 2023 Compilation** in the table. Fans have rumoured EP **Midnight Bloom since late 2024**; **Leaf has not confirmed a release date**.

**Artistry:** Lyric baritone with warm, clear dark resonance, controlled phrasing and smoky theatrical vibrato; low-register contrast with higher members. Works across rock, ballad and baroque arrangements. Influences **Freddie Mercury, Park Hyo-shin, Yiruma, Sam Smith**, film scores/gothic choral music and **Danny Elfman / Yoko Kanno**. Calm commanding, ritual-like stage presence, symbolic gestures and audience eye contact; comparatively little choreography and strong emotional delivery.

**Personality and small details:** Regal/dark stage image, gentle humour and calm offstage; polite speech, neutral clothes and **tea at rehearsals** earn an autumn-gentleman image. Prefers interviews and visual shoots over variety, where dry wit is noted. Nicknames **Autumn King (가을왕)**, **Coach Happy**, **Low Octave Prince**, the last dated to **Eerie Echoes (2020)**.

Fluent **Korean**, conversational **English**. Enjoys **antique shopping, photography, making herbal tea blends, rainy days and candlelight for songwriting**. Introspective and reflective; mediates creative planning and advises younger members. **2023 K-Wave Journal ideal type:** a quietly expressive person communicating through their eyes. Owns **over 40 pairs of boots**, many stage costumes. **Calligraphic diary entries**, shared in fan café off-season. **Avoids caffeine before performances**, chooses **honey water / herbal teas**. Stage name Happy is ironic, representing coexistence of joy and melancholy.

**Relationships and support:** Gentle paternal support within PUMPKING; close **Dexter friendship** described as honest/creative; helps **Draco** with lyrical flow and phrasing. Lex confirms Happy is PUMPKING’s oldest member and Dexter is both the group’s leader and Happy’s boyfriend. The article’s friendship wording describes their working dynamic alongside their romantic relationship. **Kindred Hearts** annual charity for mental-health awareness and artistic therapy; anonymous gifts to **Daegu low-income music education**, with occasional off-season school visits.

The source credits him with lifting PUMPKING beyond a seasonal novelty and influencing trainee vocal/storytelling approaches.

#### Wiki biography and creative profile — Draco

The saved [Draco biography, revision 4317](https://leafentertainment.fandom.com/wiki/Draco?oldid=4317), dated 23 October 2025 and included in the 30 September 2026 export, gives the following account of Mun Dae. Its family, creative and career details are retained as attributed wiki evidence. Mun Dae (문대), stage name Draco (드라코), stylised **𝐃𝐑𝐀𝐂𝐎**, is described as a South Korean rapper, model and visual artist under Leaf Entertainment, and PUMPKING’s **main rapper and sub-dancer**. The infobox also labels his work as dancer/rapper, gives **ENTJ**, Seoul as hometown and Park Seonghwa as face claim; height and blood group are blank. The stage name is explained as Latin for dragon, evoking transformation, fluidity and fire. The source portrait is named DracoBio.png; its pixels were not reviewed.
##### Family, education and training

The wiki places his birth in **Gwangju on 27 October 2000**. The month and day agree with the saved calendar. Its historical **1998** field stays preserved beside Lex’s tentative **2000** selection and report that Canopy has been corrected; Draco’s third-oldest place after Happy and Dexter is confirmed. He is the youngest of three siblings; neither older sibling is named. His mother is Korean-American and works in film translation; his father is a Korean stage designer. Childhood visits to theatre rehearsals nurtured an interest in costume design and lighting, while his mother introduced Western cinema and literature, influencing his self-expression.

He attended Gwangju Arts High School for contemporary media studies and then moved to Seoul to pursue music. The account describes a **2017–2023 trainee period at SK Entertainment**, in its theatrical, performance-focused **Shadowline** division, which was eventually shelved. Rap, fashion and photography were equal interests, and he designed looks for evaluation stages. It separately says he joined Leaf after a **2023 audition with the self-written rap Mirror’s Edge**, whose lyricism and charisma attracted attention, and that Leaf assigned him to the developing PUMPKING concept team. The SK/Leaf Shadowline labels and dates require comparison rather than an assumed merger.
##### PUMPKING and songwriting

The infobox and debut paragraph say **1 October 2023**, with the single album **Halloween Night**, and years active **2023–present**. The section heading instead says **2018–Present**. The biography credits his sharp tone and charisma in the haunting debut performance and describes unnamed critics praising his balance of aggression and theatrical restraint.

His rap mixes theatrical delivery and introspective poetics: shifting tempo, spoken-word cadence and visual imagery within PUMPKING’s gothic setting. Themes include metamorphosis, identity distortion, duality, self-image and liberation through art. The article attributes a smoky, rasped tone that can move from whisper to controlled growl, with influences **Tablo, Zico, Lorde, Aesop Rock**, and poets **Ocean Vuong and Han Kang**. It says he contributes to nearly every group release, sometimes ghostwriting secondary verses to preserve cohesion; mirrors, masks and reflection are recurring lyrical signatures, alongside dark humour, literary references and unpredictable rhythms.
- **Graveyard Disco (2020):** layered wordplay in its rap break.
- **Phantom Waltz (2021):** a dramatic verse performed in a lace corset and military coat.
- **Things Go Bump (2023):** a haunting bridge set against Dexter and Happy’s choral harmonies.
The first two performance years precede the article’s stated 2023 group debut. A pre-debut explanation is not established.

Within PUMPKING he is described as a conceptual provocateur who pushes visual and lyrical boundaries. He shares a creative partnership with **Dexter** on lyrics and performance tone, and works with **Duke** on visual concepts and wardrobe. Members call him the muse who keeps the group unpredictable; he encourages younger members to express individuality rather than pretend to be normal.
##### Modelling, fashion and BEDROCK

The biography says his modelling career began in **2023**, after **Verve** scouted him for its **Gothic Revival** showcase. It describes international runway work in **Seoul, Los Angeles, London and Capitolium**, with androgynous tailoring, fluid silhouettes and expressive gestures or eye contact that blend fashion and performance art. Named runway clients are **Sprig Atelier** (Korea), **Massively™** (Los Angeles), **Róhe Unveil** (Usan), **Anders & Sonne** (Denmark), **Maison Hyeri** (Paris Fashion Week) and **XEN Archive** (New York Fashion Week). Cover appearances are named for **VOGUE Korea, BEDROCK Magazine, Dazed Seoul** and **Branch Homme**, often exploring fluid identity and post-gender aesthetics.

His first BEDROCK appearance is nevertheless dated **2020: the Monarch Issue**, with Victorian gowns and corsetry styled by Verve founder **Choi Taeyang**, under artistic direction from publication founder **Callum Myung**. The article calls it a viral queer-fashion breakthrough. It also names the **2022 AndroGenesis issue** and **2024 Future Flesh centrefold**, both challenging conventional masculinity. These dates conflict with the stated 2023 start of modelling and are preserved rather than silently changed.

Draco and Callum are described as developing a romance by **late 2021**, based on respect for one another’s art, and publicly confirming their engagement in **early 2023** through the BEDROCK feature **Our Quiet Revolution**. The wiki dates have not been independently established. The already-read [Moon Cake scene](https://bluehour.jcink.net/index.php?showtopic=79345&view=findpost&p=2356996) separately shows them engaged on **14 February 2025**, and [Dae’s earlier exchange](https://bluehour.jcink.net/index.php?showtopic=79345&view=findpost&p=2356546) mentions a period apart that helped clarify their love; it does not date that separation. They co-own the Los Angeles creative studio **TAS**.

His offstage clothes include skirts, mesh blouses, heels and corsets, combining masculine structure and feminine fluidity. The article frames fashion as rebellion, reconciliation and recognition of different parts of himself; it also describes a willingness to try clothes that frighten him. He is ambidextrous and wears mismatched rings to symbolise balance and contradiction. Verve trainees are said to study his deliberate, rhythmically minimal runway walk.
##### Advocacy, personality and private life

The account says he advocates **queer visibility and body neutrality**, collaborates with **Verve for All** on genderless design and inclusive modelling, and has spoken at creative panels in **Los Angeles and Seoul** about art as resistance and self-expression. In **2023** he co-curated BEDROCK’s **Unbody Project**, a hybrid fashion exhibition exploring digital identity and human form. He and Callum are described as advocates for LGBTQIA+ representation in Korean media who use their platforms to support emerging queer artists.

The wiki contrasts an intense, theatrical stage presence, sharp gestures and serpentine movement with an articulate, reflective offstage manner. ### Boba relationship and life details

[Hunter and Soomin’s relationship history](https://chatgpt.com/space/page_5ceb6bf89adc81919cc31bdc9af4c007) follows rebuilding trust, chosen-family support, daily habits and their shared home. The [375 curated rows](https://chatgpt.com/space/page_18bbb4e9a42c8191891ad550084dcdd6) and [346 evidence-register rows](https://chatgpt.com/space/page_c632bdcb12ac81919e3d8f014a5f6b77) were reviewed on 3 October; these add no direct forum-post credit. Current PI age 26 is retained beside older Bible/dossier ages.

**Agency in the relationship:** He says he never agreed to stop dating and did not know whether Hunter was safe. He asks for an apology without excuses, then separately forgives the disappearance during their riverside scene. He chooses Hunter deliberately and asks for love, respect, time, patience and consistent effort. They remain unmarried partners.

**Recovery and support:** After sexual assault in Seoul, a woman found him and called an ambulance. Alexander persisted until he confided, involved Taka, Sergei, Junho, Minh and Diego, and personally funded individual security. The Bible reports prosecution and imprisonment but does not establish precise sentences. His group, music, fans, trusted conversation and Hunter help him recover; ending therapy does not mean nightmares or triggers vanished.

**Boundaries:** His trauma story is his to share in his own time. Earlier renewed overnights are cuddle-only, and later intimacy requires specific consent, chosen pace and control over triggering touch. Protective care should preserve ordinary independence. Public acknowledgement and a Halloween kiss do not open their private life to fans.

**Home and routines:** The Bible shows the move to their shared apartment, with Diego packing, Tawin moving boxes and a guard/manager checking security. He is described as the first 15tg member to move out. Seafood jjangmyeong and peach soju accompany the move. During Hunter’s space crisis he stays in Diego’s room, respects the request, and returns after an apology acknowledging their shared home.

**Small preferences and hobbies:** He loves animals and imagines a zoo or turtle sanctuary as an alternative career. He has mixed yarn, metal needles and unfinished scarves, learns sewing through YouTube, owns a heavy trinket box, and livestreams Minecraft. He likes bubble tea, Chinese food and sweet, milky, weak coffee; his named café order is a venti hazelnut latte with an extra shot, whipped cream and chocolate sprinkles.

**Close ties and creative wishes:** Diego’s quiet companionship, coffee rituals, help with the move and offered room matter to him. **Lex confirms they are very close and Soomin happily admits a crush on Diego, within their understanding of his commitment to Hunter** (5 November 2026, UQ31). This does not establish another pairing. He supports Dongmin with ordinary contact such as boba and prefers his name to formal honorifics. He enjoys songwriting, plans an upbeat solo song with Diego approved by Yejoon, and imagines a shared love song with Hunter; release/completion is unshown.

**Affection and future:** He calls Hunter handsome, handsome prince and lovely boyfriend. Hunter’s sunflower means bright and lovely; home and soulmate express safety. A Bali wedding, marriage in their home and children when older remain wishes, with no engagement, wedding, pregnancy or child established in this review.

**Direct studio support scene, updated 27 October:** [Peach Boba](https://bluehour.jcink.net/index.php?showtopic=117352&st=0#entry3419151) now has all four originals read, adding Soomin’s own answer: he came because he missed Hunter. He asks for a short busy text and feels wanted when Hunter’s reminder to text him actually rings. Hunter, Diego, Alexander and Minh feel safe to him, while fear of unfamiliar men continues. He respects the unfinished-song boundary and encourages positive love songs. A puzzle, ttukbaegi bulgogi, a later Minecraft stream and telling his manager before travelling home are discussed; no message, departure, dinner or stream is shown. The [history](https://chatgpt.com/space/page_5ceb6bf89adc81919cc31bdc9af4c007) retains exact bodies and checkpoints. Current ending is Lex/Soomin pid3420054, literally Today at 06:06 am; Sara/Hunter next, no deadline. No engagement, wedding or child follows from the Bali report.

Park Taein (박태인), born 6 February 1995; displayed age 31. Born Seoul; hometown Nichols Canyon, Los Angeles. MBTI ESTJ. CEO; years active 2022–present. Face claim Park Junhee.

Started at Leaf in 2022 as general manager overseeing trainee camp operations and mentoring prospective idols. Chosen as Taking Root judge in late 2022 with the intended subsequent role of managing its winning group, TO@ME.
Firm, disciplined and sarcastic judging style brought praise and criticism and was parodied in online sketches.

The wiki says a romantic and sexual relationship with contestant and eventual winner Haneul during production was revealed in 2023. It attributes lack of professional consequences to the fictional Jinseok’s Law protecting consensual relationships from retroactive punishment.
Later managed Hunter Park and CREEM CHEESE, Cakey Wakey’s winners. Became Head of Talent overseeing all idol and artist management.

Jacaranda Hotel was a joint venture with then COO Aaron Wang and Lim Hotels founder Seojun Lim. **Lex confirms the Jacaranda shooting date as 14 February 2025**, chronicled in [Moon Cake](https://bluehour.jcink.net/index.php?showtopic=79345). This article’s mid-2024 date is a superseded source claim; its months-long coma account remains separately attributed and does not establish exact recovery dates. He returned to executive operations after recovery.

The wiki reports his relationship with Haneul ended around his recovery and that he was rumoured to be dating HR head Dominic Lim. Dominic is explicitly stated to have no family relationship with Seojun Lim.
The article says he became CEO in early 2025 during restructuring and completed stock market flotation. It says direct management of .KANE, rescued from another label, began in mid 2025.
Low public profile outside professional duties despite scrutinised relationships and business controversies. Infobox associations: Taking Root, TO@ME, Cakey Wakey, CREEM CHEESE, Hunter and .KANE.

**Source differences and identity care:** Wiki completed flotation early 2025 versus forum July 2025 announcement of a future IPO. Wiki mid 2024 Jacaranda shooting versus Taehwan’s February 2025 Valentine’s shooting and forum February 2025 launch planning. Jinseok’s Law descriptions vary between consensual relationship protection and sexuality / gender worker protection; treat as fictional source accounts, not real legal guidance.
All visible article text was read; embedded images have not been visually interpreted.
### Aaron’s mentorship and artist confidence

The [Ginger management reference](https://chatgpt.com/space/page_286f02203ec88191b9830c37c016d854) preserves Taein’s cautious route into Jinseok’s wish to come out: he first asks about equal professional protection through Hyunwoo’s example, expressly respects confidential information and admits he cannot guarantee Leaf’s response. Before naming Jinseok he asks that a confidence should not trigger punishment; Aaron promises privacy. Taein reports Jinseok’s strain under secrecy and argues for public freedom as well as commercial opportunity. His claims about publicity figures and financial returns remain attributed arguments, not independently verified results. SRC-0153–0171; [Walnut Squares, offsets 20–30](https://bluehour.jcink.net/index.php?showtopic=53323&st=20).

Aaron’s side of the same history pairs promotion advocacy and direct praise with requests for costed plans and board presentations. He wants Taein to lead the next show’s name and concept and says he does not want to lose him at Leaf, while anticipating less TO@ME contact after promotion. Approval of a coming-out interview and a later suggested delay remain separate stages, with no publication or exact action date selected; Cakey Wakey retains Lex’s 2025 year. CLM-0017–0021, 0037–0046, 0051–0060.
### Earlier privacy crisis with Haneul and Noel

The [complete Rice Balls archive](https://chatgpt.com/space/page_9eae860783608191851974aa376b6304), all 33 original posts read 29 October 2026, preserves Taein as Haneul’s boyfriend before the later Dom relationship. He brings old friend Detective Inspector Noel Hampton into a threatened exposure, methodically checks alibis and comforts Haneul through touch and direct reassurance. He protects Haneul’s boundary with Jamie by requiring a phone call rather than an uncomfortable visit. [Introduction](https://bluehour.jcink.net/index.php?showtopic=55614&st=0#entry1716870), [boundary](https://bluehour.jcink.net/index.php?showtopic=55614&st=20#entry1779577).

After Noel attributes the photo and anonymous message to Seoyeon, Taein responds to her apology with compassion. He says he is not mad but upset she felt unable to come to him, recognising isolation and fear surrounding her sexuality and an unnamed girlfriend’s breakup. His intention to provide better support and rebuild trust is not a completed later outcome, and Haneul’s separate anger remains. [Final original post](https://bluehour.jcink.net/index.php?showtopic=55614&st=30#entry1963657), literally Aug 9 2024, 08:55 AM, is a historical ending rather than a current reply cue.

## Private humour and imagination

Reserved, clinical and composed in serious settings, Taein privately enjoys exaggerated dramatic thoughts inspired by **ancient mythologies**. He lets that quirk show when alone or with someone trusted, with **Haneul** explicitly named. He enjoys dry, sarcastic, cynical humour; unexpected dark twists; quick cheeky answers to hypothetical questions; teasing and deflection in emotional moments. He can keep replaying an absurd punchline as a private lift. He enjoys his own company and makes himself laugh; the notes explicitly distinguish this from loneliness.

Small victories, such as remembering an old account password, feel like outsmarting his routine. He jokes about Wednesdays representing the grind, underused unlimited-phone-plan benefits, internet follower counts treated as mythical status, and each newly bought garment feeling suddenly essential. He likes a mushroom metaphor: soft/unassuming outside, surprising or unsettling beneath. These are character metaphors and quirks, not evidence of hacking, magical identity or actual plot events.
## Affection, vulnerability and relationships

Taein wants to be **someone’s favourite person** but rarely admits it. He quietly observes social dynamics to gauge his importance, wonders about his significance when alone or with Haneul, and struggles to trust that his attention will be returned. Seeing people move easily between relationships feeds his self-doubt. He needs **directness and reassurance**, misses subtle cues, replays conversations and masks insecurity with humour or indifference.

Meaningful compliments leave him awkward and internally overwhelmed; he offers stilted thanks or jokes while trying to conceal how much they matter. When a connection feels special, even ordinary conversations seem adorable and become his day’s highlight; he wants them to continue and dislikes saying goodbye. He appreciates passionate, authentic nerds who can talk about an obscure interest at length, and secretly likes being drawn into that world.

He expresses genuine affection through teasing, sarcasm and spontaneous adrenaline rather than overtly soft declarations. Playfulness, including brushing crumbs off the bed as a joke, makes intimacy less tense. Notes about casual physical encounters describe emotional detachment, dry humour and privately unacknowledged dissatisfaction at that story point; they do not establish a present relationship change.

Unresolved tension bothers him: if an angry boyfriend is nearby while he needs food from the kitchen, he weighs speaking, giving space and simply getting food, feeling anxiety about the silence. He views dating actors sceptically because skill at pretending triggers doubts about sincerity. Being ignored feels disrespectful even while he appears unbothered. In close friendship, he values being able to discuss personal/taboo topics without pretence or awkwardness.
## Energy, coping and irritations

Taein needs long periods of **peace and solitude** after relatively small bursts of productivity; energy varies and he prioritises resetting over constant hustle. Ageing worries him through lost time, unfulfilled goals and pressure to have life sorted; jokes hide those fears. His persistence combines cynicism with quiet hope: he stays around for the chance that something good may come, without openly chasing happiness.

Music can breach his emotional defences; he may listen for hours, simultaneously comforted and overwhelmed, discovering feelings he had not acknowledged. Video games offer escape, though seeing his reflection in a loading screen briefly jolts him back to reality. His practical fantasy of comfort includes a city apartment, decent job, dog, Wi-Fi, television and an intimate partner; this is a **wish list**, not proof of dog ownership or an actual residence change.

Slow/unresponsive Wi-Fi particularly irritates him, including when technically connected. He sometimes finds people irrationally annoying, recognises it and withdraws without causing a scene. He may zone out of group discussions and mask missing context by nodding or joking. At parties he can appear fine while still processing a hard year. Attraction flusters him; he tries to hide it. He dislikes simplistic good-vibes/self-care advice presented as a cure-all, and feels isolated when he notices manipulation others miss.

- A Jamie vignette dismisses something and says his mother has said worse; another has a greeting met with firm rejection. These short panels lack a full exchange or absolute story date.
- A Noel vignette combines a compliment, a confident response and admiration for confidence. Do not infer which bubble belongs to whom beyond the visible labels.

- Other short references concern needing a hug, bad self-confidence about whether someone likes him, missing good hair days, sarcastic gossip, midlife crises at nineteen, marriage-versus-breakup anxiety, and being less calm than he tells others to be. A car-impact joke is **not** evidence that Taein was struck by a car.

- A relationship aphorism values someone who acknowledges change and still works for the relationship, rather than merely promising forever; it is a saved reference, not a literal promise to a named partner.

### Clementine relationship and character

Siwoo’s initiative helped his friendship with Yuseop begin: he made time for sustained conversation while most trainees offered little beyond a greeting. They lived together and became friends and partners in crime. Siwoo’s self-described troublemaking includes stealing a manager’s card for dumplings and soju, a ban on nights out and fear that expulsion would return him to university full-time. He imagined his charm might help with management, but he was punished. The proposed indie concert and arcade date with the loser buying dinner remain plans. [Full relationship history](https://chatgpt.com/space/page_2799c5b039048191981468d78e617046); [Clementine Juice](https://bluehour.jcink.net/index.php?showtopic=56691), CLE-F0011–0026, CLE-F0089–0090.

Siwoo says he has always known he is attracted to men and openly flirts with Yuseop because he likes his face and arms. He enjoys adventurous, fun company and presents himself as confident about what he wants. His teasing can be feisty, yet he promises never to hurt Yuseop. Offers to fight other trainees or charm a manager are banter, rather than completed acts. Clementine Juice CLE-F0030–0052, CLE-F0091–0097.

He discusses physical boundaries explicitly and offers to guide the less-experienced Yuseop. His early career-first stance allows fun without expecting a serious relationship, partly because he thinks they might debut separately. Later he insists they will debut together, reassures Yuseop that he is talented and promises to watch out for him. Their mutual agreement is to keep private complications from damaging work. His earlier beliefs remain historical; the later PI names Yuseop as his partner. Clementine Juice CHROW-004–008; current PI.

At the Jacaranda launch on Lex’s confirmed 14 February 2025 action date, years of training and practice culminate in CRAZHES’ official debut. Siwoo’s joy feels complete with Yuseop beside him, and he is energetic and ready rather than consumed by stage nerves. Their discreet hand contact before performing is practical mutual reassurance. Moon Cake CLE-F0098–0118; the existing CRAZHES and Moon Cake entries corroborate the debut date.

Siwoo’s police costume for the first PUMPKING Halloween party is an inexpensive market purchase from the previous day, with long sleeves, a crooked badge and small plastic cuffs. He scrolls memes while Yuseop prepares, then gives Yuseop his full attention when arrival anxiety surfaces. Backstage he teases Yuseop about eyeliner, gravitates toward him on stage and later asks permission to kiss him, making room for a refusal. Yuseop consents. Pumpkin Pie CLE-F0125–0158.

Siwoo’s family remains in Korea. During the kidnapping lockdown he treats Yuseop’s family as the closest family support around him, but the geographical distance does not prove estrangement. He respects Yuseop’s private morning calls with his twin Kia. Although frightened and having nightmares, Siwoo says he is fine; proximity, touch and warmth with Yuseop calm him. No diagnosis or recovery outcome is supplied. Clementine Posset CLE-F0167–0180; REL-003; Q-010, Q-013.

His everyday habits include inconsistent skincare despite owning products, using a pore-minimising cleanser and thick face cream during the quiet dorm morning, and borrowing Yuseop’s shirt and boxers. He is comfortable sharing bathroom space and seeks snuggles and private time before group company. He and Yuseop see themselves as the lively members who keep CRAZHES from being too serious. Their breakfast and corridor plans are not completed in this captured portion. Clementine Posset CLE-F0170–0193.

### Supporting colleagues while keeping a messenger boundary

In [Victoria Sponge](https://bluehour.jcink.net/index.php?showtopic=56218), Byungjoon relays the CEOs’ wish for Aaron to front a statement supporting consensual idol relationships and a proposed security-budget increase. His suggestion that a future company-structure change might make Aaron a shareholder is conditional. The name taein appears once inside Aaron’s reply to this Byungjoon-labelled exchange; it does not make them the same person. Ginger SRC-0001–0015; [complete message reference](https://chatgpt.com/space/page_286f02203ec88191b9830c37c016d854).

A later source message sends Aaron a requested May 29, 9:30 a.m. meeting invitation with CEOs attending by livestream, an information pack and named invitees. Byungjoon explains that he does not know the substance and calls a possible new project his guess; he asks Aaron to relay the invitation because only the COO received it. The meeting’s occurrence and final project are unshown. The saved posting labels are historical and create no current deadline. SRC-0016–0021, [Victoria Sponge, offsets 10–20](https://bluehour.jcink.net/index.php?showtopic=56218&st=10).
